title: How developers split roles among them and a coding agent and what "collaboration" means
abstract: arXiv:2611.26668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Coding agents such as Claude Code become more and more competent, so that their role in the development process can grow.   Objective: How do developers characterize the role-split between them and their agent? How would they ideally want to collaborate with their agent?   Methods: We perform a 3-step, mixed-methods study. We apply qualitative open coding to 2025 early adopters' blog articles; perform a quantitative survey of 2026 practitioners; develop and apply a method for coding-agent-supported open coding of survey freetext responses.   Results: The 2025 practitioners have the agent work in supporting roles only. Accountability was firmly human. In 2026, both are fundamentally still true. Gradually, however, the role-split is now different, with much more agent involvement. The developers' notion of collaboration has three facets: Predominantly a separation into human-only, agent-only, and collaborative work steps, with

translated_title: 开发者如何在自身与编码智能体之间划分角色，以及“协作”意味着什么
translated_abstract: 背景：像 Claude Code 这样的编码智能体能力日益增强，因此它们在开发过程中可以承担的角色也在不断扩大。目标：开发者如何描述自己与智能体之间的角色分工？他们理想中希望如何与智能体协作？方法：我们开展了一项三步骤的混合方法研究：对 2025 年早期采用者的博客文章进行定性开放编码；对 2026 年的从业者进行定量调查；开发并应用了一种由编码智能体辅助、对调查自由文本回答进行开放编码的方法。结果：2025 年的从业者仅让智能体承担辅助性角色，责任归属牢牢地掌握在人类手中。到 2026 年，这两点基本上仍然成立。然而，角色分工正在逐渐演变，智能体的参与程度大幅提高。开发者的协作概念包含三个层面：主要是将工作划分为仅由人类完成、仅由智能体完成和协作完成的工作步骤，……
tldr: 这项混合方法研究发现，开发者在 2025 年仅让编码智能体承担辅助角色且责任始终归于人类，到 2026 年智能体参与度显著提升，开发者将“协作”理解为人类专属、智能体专属与协作工作步骤三者之间的分工。
en_tdlr: This mixed-methods study finds that developers in 2025 confined coding agents to supporting roles with accountability remaining firmly human, while by 2026 agent involvement has grown substantially and developers understand collaboration primarily as a separation of work into human-only, agent-only, and collaborative steps.
